g.text: N queens: choose, reject, undo, then try again
Yellow: next row. Red: attacked square in that row. Green: a placed queen.
Row 2 has no safe square. Return without placing
Clear its column and diagonal flags. Try the next
Row 3 has no safe square. Undo rows 2 and 1.
No row-1 choice completed the branch starting
Columns 0 and 1 are attacked in row 1; column 2
Continue with the remaining safe square in row 3.
Save a COPY of [1, 3, 0, 2]. This is one complete
Clear column 2 and both diagonal flags; keep
A safe square has a free column AND two free diagonals. Undo restores all three flags.
Example: row 2, column 0 uses column[0], rising[2 + 0], falling[2 - 0 + 4].
